attributes.text: Welcome Back! To get the most form iTriage we recommend you login or create an account:

All the information you've already saved is still there, but you'll need to create an account to continue using My iTriage. All of your information will be moved into your account after you create it.

If you've already created an account on another device or online, just click "Log In" to use that account.My iTriage
